description: The self-hosted run of the renovate workflow reads this file through RENOVATE_CONFIG_FILE, per ADR-0117.
The repository config in .github/renovate.json merges on top of it. These rules group the pins of the platform.

packageRules.description: One repository has one dependency graph, per ADR-0111. The single go.mod produces one PR, with minor and patch together.
Bun packages: also one PR for the ecosystem.
The flake inputs: one PR for nixpkgs, tabnix, and flake-parts, so the toolchain moves as one, per ADR-0100.

Container images: one PR for the ecosystem, minor and patch together, with tag and digest together, per ADR-0117. A new digest with the same tag is a rebuild of the same version. The PR body carries both, because a reviewer cannot judge it from the diff alone.
Helm chart releases: one PR for the ecosystem, minor and patch together, per ADR-0117.
Terraform moves on its own, slower schedule.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The inner loop's local stand-ins in infra/local/*.yaml: Postgres, the Temporal dev server, OpenFGA, and the API mock. They get one PR, because together they are the floor an engineer runs against, per ADR-0600. None of them is deployed anywhere.
A pin adds a digest or an exact version to a reference that has none. It does not change what runs, so all pins share one PR, per ADR-0117.
A major version is a decision, so it is proposed alone, never joins a group, and opens only after a person ticks it on the dashboard, per ADR-0117. This rule is after every group rule, so it wins.
Held at 3.x: postcss depends on nanoid ^3. The root override only lifts the 3.x line to a patched release. A major breaks postcss.

customManagers.description: The forge and runner kits pin the release they install on a machine, per ADR-0116. A marker comment above each pin names its image, so the release moves with the same weekly batch as the chart that pins the same Forgejo.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A CVE with a fixed version is proposed at once, outside the batch, and without dashboard approval even for a major. For this class only, the weekly slot is too slow, per ADR-0117 and ADR-0113.
